caveats.en: ST says it does not yet ship native Windows on Arm drivers for ST-LINK probes, so STM32CubeProgrammer can't use them out of the box. A user-reported WinUSB registry workaround exists but is unofficial.
caveats.zh-TW: ST 表示尚未提供 ST-LINK 的原生 Windows on Arm 驅動程式，STM32CubeProgrammer 無法直接使用。有使用者分享改用 WinUSB 並修改登錄檔的做法，但並非官方方案。

evidence.title: ST Community: no native Windows on Arm ST-LINK drivers yet (ST moderator, Oct 2025)
